verdict_rules.Met: Inside the promised range, or at most 5 percentage points above a stated floor (T_floor <= actual <= T_floor + 5.0)
verdict_rules.Beat: More than 5 percentage points above the top of the range or stated floor (actual > T_top + 5.0)
verdict_rules.Missed: Below the floor or range (actual < T_floor or actual < T_min)
verdict_rules.Unclear: Delivered metric differs from promised metric (revenue vs volume), or no comparable figure disclosed

audit_summary.note: Prepared remarks across 5 transcripts contain historical operational reviews only; no checkable forward numerical guidance.

annual_report_facts.statement: Consolidated annual sales reached ₹14,601 Cr in FY26 (+11.1% YoY from ₹13,140 Cr in FY25).
Operating profit stood at ₹3,521 Cr with an Operating Profit Margin of 24.1% in FY26.
Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) reached ₹2,471 Cr in FY26 (+17.9% YoY from ₹2,096 Cr in FY25).
Total consolidated borrowings stood at ₹417 Cr against total assets of ₹15,399 Cr (virtually debt-free balance sheet).
Consolidated fixed assets stood at ₹5,774 Cr with ₹329 Cr in Capital Work in Progress (CWIP).
